meta.name: github-gist
meta.description: Publish files or Obsidian notes as GitHub Gists. Use when user wants to share code/notes publicly, create quick shareable snippets, or publish markdown to GitHub. Triggers include "publish as gist", "create gist", "share on github", "make a gist from this".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将文件或笔记快速发布为 GitHub Gist
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速创建可分享的代码片段或笔记链接
copy.tagline_en: Publish files or notes as GitHub Gist quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create shareable code snippets or note links

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求发布文件或笔记时，Claude会用GitHub Gist生成一个分享链接。默认创建不公开的Gist，也可以选择公开。
howto.when: 当你说出“发布为Gist”、“创建Gist”、“分享到GitHub”等关键词，或要求把文件/笔记共享时触发。

say.text: 把这段代码分享到GitHub Gist。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude can publish files or notes as GitHub Gists, returning a shareable link. By default creates secret (unlisted) gists; public option available.
howto.when_en: Triggers when user says "publish as gist", "create gist", "share on github", "make a gist from this", or asks to share a file/note as a gist.

say_en.text: Publish this note as a gist.
say_en.note: Creates a secret gist by default.

say_en.text: Share this code on GitHub Gist.
